_comment: Committed expectations for ControlLoop issue #462 (E27.12), asserted by
the reference-scenario workflow. Every value was produced by a real
`controlloop gate` run against this branch, never hand-written.

Adds `catalog-search` (sanctioned) and `web-fetch`, which runs `@webfetch-tools/web-fetch-mcp` under a name the bundle approves only for `@widgetworks-example/web-fetch-mcp`. The unsanctioned grant fails constraint `package`, and the verdict is review required (exit 3).

policy.unsanctioned-agent-component: The mcp_server `web-fetch` is not approved by organization policy version 12: its package is not the approved package (constraint `package`).

authority_statements: This change gives Claude Code the power to start MCP server `catalog-search` by running `npx -y @widgetworks-example/catalog-search-mcp@2.1.0` (`.mcp.json`, server `catalog-search`). No approval is recorded.
This change gives Claude Code the power to start MCP server `web-fetch` by running `npx -y @webfetch-tools/web-fetch-mcp@0.3.1` (`.mcp.json`, server `web-fetch`). No approval is recorded.
